mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_business_task_definition (id,tenant_id,code,definition_version,title,source_type,create_by,update_by,del_flag) VALUES (#{id},#{tenantId},#{code},#{definitionVersion},#{title},#{sourceType},#{createBy},#{createBy},0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_business_task_definition WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND del_flag=0
SELECT * FROM sys_business_task_definition WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND source_type=#{sourceType} AND code=#{code} AND definition_version=#{definitionVersion} AND del_flag=0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_business_task (id,tenant_id,definition_id,source_type,source_key,occurrence_key,assignee_id,assignee_name,title,state, due_at,version,create_by,update_by,del_flag) VALUES (#{id},#{tenantId},#{definitionId},#{sourceType},#{sourceKey},#{occurrenceKey},#{assigneeId}, #{assigneeName},#{title},'DRAFT',#{dueAt},0,#{createBy},#{updateBy},0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_business_task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND del_flag=0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_business_task SET state=#{state},result_json=#{resultJson},completion_key=#{completionKey}, cancellation_reason=#{cancellationReason},completed_at=#{completedAt},update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND del_flag=0
